title: Warriors of Peace
summary: Warriors of peace do not fall Rise, rise A sweet mother of all be our eyes, our heavenly love always above. For we have shown this world not worthy for such abundant love Rise, rise A sweet mother of all Warriors of peace do not fall #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Warriors of peace
do not fall
Rise, rise
A sweet mother of all
be our eyes,
our heavenly love
always above.

For we have shown this world
not worthy
for such abundant love
Rise, rise
A sweet mother of all

Warriors of peace
do not fall

#smallpoems
